title: Connected Car Test Case
description: Formal schema for one row of the Connected Cars test case template. Derived empirically from 2,704 rows across 22 existing feature test suites (Existing_TestCases/) plus the AI-generation pipeline's additions (CAN/VSS signal columns). Adopted as the standard schema for all future test case authoring, manual or AI-generated, per team decision on 2026-08-06.

sr_no.description: Sequential serial number. Column 1 (Sr. No.). Continues from the last row already in the sheet - never renumber existing rows.

issue_type.description: Column 2 (Issue Type). Format Test_NN, zero-padded to at least 2 digits. Must numerically match sr_no (Test_09 <-> sr_no 9). Resets to Test_01 per feature file - do not carry numbering across features.

test_type_execution.description: Column 3 (Test Type - execution method). Empirically 2670/2704 historical rows are 'Manual'; 'Automated' has never been observed but the enum exists for when automated execution is tracked. NOTE: there is a second, unrelated column also named 'Test Type' (test_type_validation_scope, column 13) - see that field's description for the disambiguation the team explicitly chose to keep as-is rather than rename.

summary.description: Column 4 (Summary). Short, single-sentence description of what the test verifies. MUST be byte-identical to test_description (team decision: both columns exist, both carry the same short text - no separate long-form description).

parent_id.description: Column 5 (Parent ID). The feature ID this test case belongs to, e.g. NIO-F001.

requirement_id.description: Column 6 (Requirement ID). Semicolon-and-space-separated list of requirement IDs this test case verifies, e.g. 'NIO-F0001_INT_REQ_001; NIO-F0001_INT_REQ_004'. Every ID here should be traceable to a real requirement in Requirement_Docs/. Never fabricate a requirement ID.

test_description.description: Column 7 (Test Description). MUST be byte-identical to summary. Do not write a separate long-form paragraph here - this was explicitly simplified per team feedback (2026-08-06).

gherkins.description: Column 8 (Gherkins). Free text with three mandatory sections in order: 'Preconditions:', 'Test Steps:', 'Expected Result:'. Every CAN/VSS signal value asserted in Expected Result must appear verbatim in can_signals_referenced / vss_signals_referenced - no signal should be named in Gherkins that isn't also listed in those columns.

environment.description: Column 9 (Environment). ENFORCED ENUM as of 2026-08-06 - historical data has 6 spelling variants of LabCar/Vehicle/Bench (LabCar/Labcar/labcar/'Lab Car', Vehicle/vehicle, Bench) which were left un-normalized in the 22 existing files by team decision; all NEW rows must use the exact canonical casing above. 'HIL' added 2026-08-07 - confirmed real and distinct from the other three, with its own automation keyword library (see Docs/test_bench_capabilities.md and HIL_Automation/hil_keyword_index.json). A test case with environment=HIL should, where possible, reference real keywords from that index in its Gherkin steps rather than free prose - see guardrails.md.

test_set_type.description: Column 10 (Test Set Type). 2701/2704 historical rows are 'Functional' - no other value has ever been observed in this codebase. Enum kept narrow to what's empirically confirmed; widen only when a real non-functional test case actually needs a different value.

test_er_name.description: Column 11 (Test Er Name / Date & Time). Populated post-execution by whoever runs the test in the lab - legitimately blank at generation time. Not required from the AI pipeline.

testing_agency.description: Column 12 (Testing Agency). Header text lists three intended options (Labcar / PAT / TML COC) but 2701/2704 historical rows use only 'TML COC' - the other two have never actually been used. Enum includes all three per the header's stated intent.

test_type_validation_scope.description: Column 13 (also labeled 'Test Type' in the sheet - a naming collision with column 3 that the team decided to leave as-is rather than rename). This is validation SCOPE, not execution method: 2701/2704 historical rows are 'Full validation'. Do not confuse with test_type_execution (Manual/Automated).

test_set_category.description: Column 14 (Test Set Category). REQUIRED for all new/AI-generated test cases as of 2026-08-06. This field is empty in all 2,704 existing historical rows - this pipeline is the first to populate it. Legacy rows are exempt/grandfathered, not required to be backfilled unless separately scoped.

can_signals_referenced.description: Column 15 (CAN Signals Referenced) - NEW as of the AI-generation pipeline, adopted as standard schema as of 2026-08-06 (does not exist in the original 22 historical files). Pipe-delimited table: 'Signal (DBC) | Msg ID(dec) | Bit Start/Len | Tx>Rx | Values'. GUARDRAIL: every signal name + message ID + bit position here must be looked up from Schema/../Signal_Catalogs/unified_signal_index.json or dbc_raw_reference.json - never free-generated. If a signal cannot be found in either source, write 'SIGNAL NOT FOUND - flag for review' instead of guessing.

vss_signals_referenced.description: Column 16 (VSS Signals Referenced) - NEW as of the AI-generation pipeline, adopted as standard schema as of 2026-08-06. Free text grouped by tier (Internal TCU decode / External Interface-Cloud / App-facing standard VSS). GUARDRAIL: every VSS path must be looked up from unified_signal_index.json. If a CAN signal exists but has no VSS mapping in the Master Signal Catalog, say so explicitly (see Test_91's SASSUnLockAllDoorCommand for the pattern) rather than inventing a VSS path.
